infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Housewire uses the camera only when you choose to scan a join code or a camera clue. Scans are processed locally on this phone, and no photo is saved.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: HOUSEWIRE connects family phones on the same Wi-Fi for shared escape rooms and team races.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HOUSEWIRE uses the microphone only during an explicit game action: a short one-time whisper or local loudness pattern. Voice is never transcribed or archived.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Housewire uses motion to turn this phone into a physical game node.
